title: Network pharmacology analysis and experimental validation of EGCG's therapeutic effects against acute lung injury in sepsis.
authors: Jin, Xianwei; Weng, Qiaoling; Qian, Kejian; Liu, Fen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EGCG对脓毒症急性肺损伤的治疗作用，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是信号通路与炎症机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute lung injury (ALI), a severe pulmonary condition associated with sepsis, involves deterioration of alveolar and capillary endothelial cells during initial stages. Current therapeutic interventions remain insufficient. OBJECTIVE: This study investigates the therapeutic epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) on sepsis-induced ALI and its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: The effects of EGCG on M1 macrophage polarization and its glycolytic activity in sepsis models were evaluated through both in vitro and in vivo experiments. The targets of EGCG were identified using network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques, which were subsequently validated through experimental studies. The CCK-8 assay was employed to determine the optimal concentration of EGCG for maintaining the highest viability of LPS-treated RAW264.7 macrophages and bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs). The sepsis models utilized included LPS-treated cell models and murine models established via cecal ligation and puncture (CLP). These models were evaluated through various biological methodologies, including qPCR, ELISA, and Western blot analysis across multiple dimensions. RESULTS: EGCG effectively reduced the expression of HK2, PKM2, and iNOS, mitigating lung damage in CLP mice. Network pharmacology analysis identified the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) as a primary target, associated with the HIF-1alpha pathway. Mechanistically, EGCG reduced p-EGFR/EGFR, suppressing the expression of HIF-1alpha, HK2, PKM2, and iNOS. CONCLUSIONS: EGCG reduces ALI caused by sepsis by inhibiting macrophage glycolysis through the EGFR/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种与脓毒症相关的严重肺部疾病，其初始阶段涉及肺泡和毛细血管内皮细胞的恶化。当前的治疗干预措施仍显不足。目的：本研究探讨表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）对脓毒症诱导的ALI的治疗作用及其潜在分子机制。方法：通过体外和体内实验评估EGCG对脓毒症模型中M1巨噬细胞极化及其糖酵解活性的影响。利用网络药理学和分子对接技术鉴定EGCG的靶点，并通过实验研究进行验证。采用CCK-8测定法确定EGCG维持LPS处理的RAW264.7巨噬细胞和骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDMs）最高活力的最佳浓度。所用脓毒症模型包括LPS处理的细胞模型和通过盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）建立的鼠模型。这些模型通过多种生物学方法进行评估，包括qPCR、ELISA和Western blot分析，涵盖多个维度。结果：EGCG有效降低HK2、PKM2和iNOS的表达，减轻CLP小鼠的肺损伤。网络药理学分析确定表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）为主要靶点，与HIF-1α通路相关。机制上，EGCG降低p-EGFR/EGFR，抑制HIF-1α、HK2、PKM2和iNOS的表达。结论：EGCG通过EGFR/HIF-1α信号通路抑制巨噬细胞糖酵解，从而减轻脓毒症引起的ALI。
